assignments.name: Set_Record_Name
assignments.label: Set Record Name
assignments.description: Assigns the computed Name back onto the in-flight record. Before-save flows edit $Record in place with no DML — safe and free.

Flow.description:
Fundraising Quick Start: on insert or update of a GiftTransaction, sets Name to a human-readable summary derived from the donor, amount, category, and payment status.
Rendering rules (evaluated in order — first match wins): • In-Kind gifts (FQS_In_Kind__c = TRUE) → "<Donor> - In-Kind Gift on <TransactionDate>". Original Amount is intentionally $0 on in-kind gifts (the Fair Market Value carries the value on its own field), so the Name label omits the dollar figure to avoid rendering "$0". • Corporate matching gifts (MatchingEmployerTransactionId is set) → "<Employer> match - $<amt> on <TransactionDate>". • Pledge payments while unpaid (Status <> Paid) anchor on TransactionDueDate: "<Donor> - $<amt> due <TransactionDueDate>". • Pledge payments once paid (Status = Paid) flip to the completed date: "<Donor> - $<amt> paid <TransactionDate>". • All other gifts (one-time cash, earned income, event registration) → "<Donor> - $<amt> on <TransactionDate>".
Starting criteria (plain English): fires on insert OR on update when any of Donor, Original Amount, Transaction Date, Transaction Due Date, Matching Employer Transaction, Gift Transaction Category, or In-Kind flag changes. Additionally fires on Status change ONLY for Pledge Payment gifts, and only when the transition is into or out of Paid (Unpaid ↔ Paid, Pending ↔ Paid) — every other status transition (Failed, Canceled, Refunded, Written-Off) is ignored because those don't affect the rendered Name. Skipped when the running user holds the FQS_Skip_Record_Naming custom permission, when the record's FQS_Skip_Naming__c checkbox is checked, when Donor or Original Amount is blank, or when both Transaction Date and Transaction Due Date are blank (Expected/scheduled pledge installments qualify on Due Date alone).
Two opt-outs: the FQS_Skip_Record_Naming custom permission (grant via the FQS Naming Opt Out permission set, typically to integration or migration users) and the FQS_Skip_Naming__c checkbox on the record.

formulas.name: Computed_Name
formulas.expression: IF( {!Is_In_Kind}, {!Get_Donor.Name} + " - In-Kind Gift on " + TEXT({!$Record.TransactionDate}), IF( {!Is_Corp_Match}, {!Get_Donor.Name} + " match - $" + {!Amt_Text} + " on " + TEXT({!$Record.TransactionDate}), IF( {!Is_Pledge_Payment} && {!Is_Paid}, {!Get_Donor.Name} + " - $" + {!Amt_Text} + " paid " + TEXT({!$Record.TransactionDate}), IF( {!Is_Pledge_Payment}, {!Get_Donor.Name} + " - $" + {!Amt_Text} + " due " + TEXT( IF( ISBLANK({!$Record.TransactionDueDate}), {!$Record.TransactionDate}, {!$Record.TransactionDueDate} ) ), {!Get_Donor.Name} + " - $" + {!Amt_Text} + " on " + TEXT({!$Record.TransactionDate}) ))))

Flow.label: FQS Auto Name Gift Transaction

recordLookups.name: Get_Donor
recordLookups.label: Get Donor
recordLookups.description: Fetches the donor Account so its Name (First + Last for Person Accounts, Organization Name for Orgs, or the corporate employer name for matching gifts) can be composed into the record Name.

start.filterFormula: NOT( {!$Permission.FQS_Skip_Record_Naming} ) && NOT( {!$Record.FQS_Skip_Naming__c} ) && NOT( ISBLANK({!$Record.DonorId}) ) && NOT( ISBLANK({!$Record.OriginalAmount}) ) && ( NOT( ISBLANK({!$Record.TransactionDate}) ) || NOT( ISBLANK({!$Record.TransactionDueDate}) ) ) && ( ISNEW() || ISCHANGED({!$Record.DonorId}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.OriginalAmount}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.TransactionDate}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.TransactionDueDate}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.MatchingEmployerTransactionId}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c}) || ISCHANGED({!$Record.FQS_In_Kind__c}) || ( ISCHANGED({!$Record.Status}) && ISPICKVAL({!$Record.FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c}, "Pledge Payment") && ( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Status}, "Paid") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE({!$Record.Status}), "Paid") ) ) )
